content.comment_body: I set a menu access password, which now blocks switching from operator mode to admin mode. The password was forgotten. Is it possible to completely reset the base module and remove the password? I looked through the software but couldn't find a way to do this. Entering wrong passwords repeatedly didn't help either.
If you haven't tried it, the default password is typically 'logo'.

I am aware the default password is 'logo'. I changed mine and forgot the new one, and for two weeks I've been trying to erase it without any luck. Next time, and for my next four devices, I’ll write the password down.
You can delete the entire program, which also removes the password, but your program will be gone as well. This leaves you with a freshly reset device.

I couldn't find the answer in the manual regarding this theoretical scenario: How can I reset the IP address of a [product_name] base module without display back to factory settings (192.168.0.1) if the current IP is unknown? Is it possible via an SD card? The configuration software needs the current module IP address to change it, and even the connected operator device requires a known base module IP.
I've tried this multiple times. The program and most passwords seem to be removed, except for this particular password. It did not revert to 'logo' nor did it clear out.
I'm dealing with the same issue. I forgot my admin password on [product_name] and couldn't find a reset option in the manual. Can someone assist with guidance here?
You can set a new password to overwrite the old one. Please see the attached instructions.
Unfortunately, all your suggestions still require the old password, which I don't remember. It’s frustrating that [company_name] hasn't provided a solution; this wastes a lot of valuable time.
If you’ve lost your program protection password, the only way to reset is via: Tools > Transfer > Clear User Program and Password.

I'm experiencing the same issue, and none of the manuals helped. I changed the remote access password, but now the default no longer works and I can't recall what I set it to. All transfer tools require an http password, which I can't reset to the default. Even after clearing the program on the base module, the remote access password remains. Any advice would be appreciated.

After reviewing the manual more thoroughly, I found that forgotten passwords can be reset if the module is connected to a PC using the configuration software on the same network. In this case, the device does not prompt for a remote access password, allowing you to use the transfer tools to reset passwords. This might be obvious for some, but my configuration had the PC on a different network, which caused difficulty. Hope this helps others resolve the problem more quickly.

To clarify, attempting to reset the password using this option deletes the program, but the password remains. You can verify this in the password menu, where all three lines are blank instead of just two. As of December 2018, this problem persists. Does anyone know if or when this issue—likely within the configuration software—will be resolved? I'm currently using version 8.2.

Not sure if you're referring to the same password feature, since there are different functions. For deleting a password for program protection, my described method works—there’s no alternative. I attached a screen video showing: after creating a small program and setting a password for protection, I transferred it to the device and started recording. A second program transfer prompts for the password, which you need to enter. Then I deleted both the program and the password. After this, a third transfer no longer requires any password. Used version 8.2.

To reiterate, using this option deletes the program, but the password still remains. Upon returning to the password menu, all three lines are blank, which differed from the original state. As of December 2018, this issue is still unresolved. Does anyone know when it might be fixed? Using version 8.2.

You can change or delete the password using a MicroSD card. To do this, create a valid program in the configuration software and insert the SD card into your PC. Use 'Save As' in the software and keep the filename unchanged. Then insert the card into the device and perform a power cycle. This will remove the password unless you assign one in the program stored on the SD card. Hope this helps.

How did you create the password—via the device menu or the file properties of the configuration software file? If you set the password in the menu, deleting it only removes it from the device. If created in the file properties, it stays in the software file and will be restored to the device if re-transferred. To fully delete, go to file properties, access the password dialog, enter the old password, and leave the new password fields blank—this deletes it from the file.

For reference: Using version 8.1.0 and article number [article_no], I encountered a similar issue. The device lost its software, and a password was demanded during reconnection for uploading new software. Choosing 'Delete user program and password' caused an inconsistency or Java error. The root issue was mismatched IP configuration between programming console and device (including IP, Subnet, Gateway; DNS left blank). Once corrected, reloading the software worked without problems.

analysis.insight_summary: Users often forget admin or menu access passwords on their devices, resulting in loss of access to important configuration functions. The reset and recovery procedures are confusing and lack proper documentation, leading to frustration. Even after deleting user programs, the password may persist, and official resources do not provide clear solutions for recovery without the original password. There is a consistent absence of easy troubleshooting steps and users expect more intuitive support for such frequent issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a straightforward method to reset or restore forgotten device passwords without needing the previous password or erasing important programs. They prefer better guidance and documentation from [company_name] to address these common usability problems efficiently.
